seriesTitle: Night Stalker: The Hunt for a Serial Killer

episodes.title: Devil in the City of Angels
episodes.summary: A series of murders, rapes and kidnappings baffles police until detectives Gil Carrillo and Frank Salerno team up and start connecting the crimes.

episodes.title: Anyone Could Be Next
episodes.summary: Scant clues and a rapidly rising body count take a toll on detectives Carrillo and Salerno — but an impounded vehicle may lead to a break.

episodes.title: Lock. Your. Doors.
episodes.summary: A missed opportunity to catch the killer now labeled the "Night Stalker" frustrates detectives, as does a mayor who divulges evidence to the press.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.summary: Detectives identify their suspect and a manhunt begins – but it's the public that rises up to stop the Night Stalker's deadly reign of terror.
